C0658.title: Anti-Collection Syndicates Incite Debtors to File Malicious Complaints Against Banks
C0658.summary: Anti-collection syndicates coach debtors to lodge malicious complaints through the CBIRC complaint hotline, distorting facts and falsely accusing banks to coerce them into waiving interest or granting repayment extensions. Exploiting regulatory pressure on complaint resolution rates, they force banks into concessions to secure illegitimate debt relief benefits.

references.title: 'Anti-collection alliance' surges, how should banks respond to malicious complaints? _ Tencent News
